hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$sid" ] && sid=$$; port=$(( $(printf '%s' "$sid" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 300 + 5200 )); lan=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || echo 127.0.0.1); url="http://$lan:$port/drill-board/"; if lsof -iTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else ( nohup npx vite --host --port $port --strictPort >"/tmp/drillboard-vite-$port.log" 2>&1 & ); fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Auto-started the LAN dev server for this session at %s (log /tmp/drillboard-vite-%s.log). Keep this URL as an always-available clickable link and re-share it whenever showing a change. This project starts in plan mode."}}\n' "$url" "$port"
